title: Blinkwire
tagline: Turn the tiles. Wake every sleepy eye in Oddvale.
description: The lamps of Oddvale are sleepy little eyes. Turn the wire tiles until every one of them is joined to the Big Eye and blinks awake, with no loose ends. 60 journey levels, a daily board with streaks, and endless free play.
difficultyNote: Calm, with no way to fail. Later chapters bring big boards that wrap around the edges.
coverAlt: Illustration: an odd little robot electrician on a stepladder plugs a cable into a wall of angular wires, where eye-shaped lamps are waking up one by one.
